name: PM YASASVI – Top Class Education in Schools (Classes 11–12)
provider: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India
summary: Central support for eligible OBC, EBC and DNT students in notified Top Class Schools; Class 11–12 students should verify the school list and available slots.
benefits: Up to ₹1,25,000 per year for Classes 11–12 under the scheme guidelines; eligible fee components and limits apply.

eligibility.incomeLimit: Family income ceiling and school/slot conditions apply; check current guidelines.

applicationProcess: Apply through NSP when the relevant fresh/renewal window is open.
statusNote: NSP 2026–27 listing shows application till 30 November 2026. Confirm fresh/renewal eligibility and state/class slots on NSP.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of India
summary: Post-matric financial support for eligible students with benchmark disabilities continuing education after Class 10. Course, disability and income rules apply.
benefits: Support varies by course group and includes notified maintenance, fees and allowances; see current guidelines for exact rates.

eligibility.income: Family-income ceiling applies; verify current guidelines.

applicationProcess: Submit through NSP when applications are open and follow institute verification.
statusNote: NSP 2026–27 listing shows student applications till 30 November 2026; check scheme specifications for exact rates.

name: Education Assistance to Wards of Beedi, Cine and Mine Workers – Post-Matric
provider: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
summary: Education assistance for eligible students whose parent is an eligible beedi, cine or specified mine worker. Worker-service, income and academic conditions apply.
benefits: Amount depends on course/class and current Ministry guidelines; check the official notice.

eligibility.parentEmployment: Parent must meet the eligible worker and service conditions.

applicationProcess: Apply through NSP during the notified cycle.
statusNote: NSP lists the 2026–27 post-matric student window as closed on 31 October 2026.

name: HDFC Bank Parivartan ECSS – Class 11–12
provider: HDFC Bank Parivartan (programme administrator details on official site)
summary: Corporate education assistance for school students facing financial difficulty or a family/personal crisis; selection is subject to programme criteria.
benefits: The official programme page lists category-specific support. Confirm the current award amount and cycle before applying.

eligibility.marks: Minimum previous-year marks and income conditions apply; verify current cycle.

applicationProcess: Use the official ECSS programme application route when the current cycle is accepting applications.
statusNote: Corporate programme; do not rely on previous-cycle deadlines or amounts.
